verdict.rationale: New Relic's own docs say services can be instrumented with OpenTelemetry and that OpenTelemetry data integrates with the platform's analysis capabilities. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents sending telemetry directly over OTLP or a native OTLP ingest endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a native OTLP endpoint for direct export, details on supported signals and protocols (traces, metrics, logs; gRPC/HTTP), and independent or hands-on corroboration of first-class OTel support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send telemetry directly over OTLP with first-class OpenTelemetry support

citations.quote: Instrument your service with OpenTelemetry and gain platform-agnostic observability.
By integrating OpenTelemetry with New Relic, you can leverage a wide range of platform capabilities to analyze the data and diagnose problems.
